correctness.rationale: For any finite connected loopless simple graph (trees included), consistency of subdivision path flows yields Z(G_r)=UZ(G), UᵀU=diag(r_e). Orthogonal projection is U B(Bᵀ R B)^{-1}BᵀUᵀ, entries H_fe replicated on each path, so ℓ1 norm C is max_e Σ_f r_f|H_fe| and Q column sum is 1+A_e−2H_ee. Weighted projection diagonal satisfies 0≤r_e H_ee<1 because no one-edge circulation. Thus all r_e≥2 force strict per-column cut domination. For uniform r, H=C_G/r gives invariant cycle norm, exact monotone cut norm, limit 1+∥C_G∥, gap≤2/r. Direct independent incidence-Laplacian calculation for K5 reproduces cut 8/5, cycle 9/5 before and cut 11/5, cycle 9/5 after r=2; source verify_subdivision.py was read as corroboration, not proof. Boundary case tree gives C=0,Q=I.
